angle_gap: The page dismisses skills testing as just one bullet among several assessment methods ('great for knowledge but not always right for competency'), then moves on — it never addresses the well-documented problem that self-reported skills inventories get inflated, or how to validate reported skill levels against objective proof.

distinct_angle: AIHR treats testing as a throwaway line item beside self-assessment and never flags self-report inflation; ours builds the inventory process around objective, validated skill testing as the backbone, with self-assessment only as a starting signal — closing the credibility gap this page leaves open.
